Privacy policy

Effective date: 17 October 2026

This policy covers Against All Ads for Android (package com.semcoding.againstallads) and this website. The game is published under the developer name Semcoding. For questions or requests, contact secretsearchgroup@proton.me.

The game stores progress on your device. Gameplay statistics are optional. Advertising uses Google's separate privacy choices. This website has no analytics tags or advertising scripts.

1. Local game data

The game saves your current run, maze state, settings, achievements and daily results in app storage on your device. We do not run an account system or a cloud-save service. Local saves are not sent to our gameplay analytics service. Android device backup and restore, if enabled, are governed by your device and Google account settings.

You can erase local game data through Android's app storage settings. Doing so removes your progress and preferences. Uninstalling normally removes local app data, although device backups may remain under your control.

2. Optional gameplay statistics

GameAnalytics is initialized only after you opt in to Share gameplay statistics. You can decline at first launch or turn it off later in Settings. Declining does not change the gameplay.

If enabled, we send fixed gameplay events and numeric measurements, including mode and region, level starts and completions, deaths, chest effects, ad outcomes, tutorial use, time played, step totals, exploration percentage and sampled performance. We do not send your maze route, individual movement inputs, screenshots, screen recordings or typed text.

The GameAnalytics SDK also handles technical and pseudonymous metadata such as installation/session identifiers, device and operating system information, and network-derived approximate location. Our integration disables GameAnalytics advertising-ID tracking and automatic error and hardware-health reporting. This is separate from Google's advertising SDK.

We use these statistics to improve difficulty, reliability and performance. Turning statistics off clears the app's pending event queue and disables SDK event submission. This does not retroactively erase previously submitted data; an initialized SDK may still make its own configuration requests. Details: GameAnalytics privacy notice and retention policy.

3. Advertising and consent

The game integrates Google AdMob for interstitial and optional rewarded ads. Depending on availability, it can show an in-game parody instead. A parody displayed entirely by the game does not itself send an ad request to an external advertiser. Test releases may use Google's test ads.

Google's Mobile Ads SDK may collect and share IP addresses and approximate location, advertising/app-set identifiers, ad and app interactions, and diagnostics to deliver and measure ads and prevent fraud. Handling depends on your region, consent and device settings. Google describes these categories in its SDK data disclosure and advertising privacy information.

Where required, Google's consent form appears before ads are requested. You can revisit Privacy choices in the game's Settings where Google makes that option available. You can also use Android's advertising-ID controls. Advertising consent and optional gameplay analytics are separate choices. Refusing personalized ads does not necessarily prevent all SDK processing or all ads.

4. Support messages and this website

If you email support, we receive your email address, message and any attachments you choose to send. We use them to answer your request and investigate problems. Please avoid sending passwords, payment information or other sensitive data.

This website does not set its own tracking cookies, load third-party advertising or analytics scripts, or collect form submissions. Its hosting and security providers may process IP addresses, request details and technical logs to deliver and protect the website. Clicking an external link or emailing support takes you to the relevant provider's service.

5. Recipients, security and international processing

Data may be processed by Google for advertising and consent, GameAnalytics for opted-in analytics, our website hosting provider, and our email provider for support. These providers may process data in countries other than your own, under their applicable terms and safeguards. We may disclose information when required by law or necessary to protect against abuse. SDK data is transmitted over encrypted connections; no system can guarantee absolute security.

6. Retention and your choices

Local game data remains until you clear it or remove the app, subject to device backups. Support correspondence is kept as needed to handle the issue and meet applicable legal obligations. Provider-held advertising and analytics data follows the relevant provider's retention and deletion processes; disabling a setting does not automatically delete historical records.

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or restrict personal data, object to processing, withdraw consent, and complain to a data-protection authority. Email secretsearchgroup@proton.me with the subject “Against All Ads privacy request”. We may need enough information to identify the relevant record and verify your request. We cannot identify every installation from an email address alone, and may need to coordinate with the SDK provider.

7. Children

The game is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly seek personal data from children under that age. If you believe a child has provided personal data through the game or support, contact us so we can investigate and take appropriate action.

8. Changes

We will update this page when our practices change and revise the effective date. Where required, we will request a new consent or provide an additional notice in the game.
